pair.description: Two bits per trit; trit i occupies bits 2i+1..2i (NUM-02).

planes.code_bit_order: minus plane bit, plus plane bit
planes.description: Two bit-planes; bit i of the plus plane (bits n-1..0) and bit i of the minus plane (bits 2n-1..n) give trit i as plus minus minus (NUM-03).

invalid_word: All 2n bits set. Every operation that receives an operand holding an invalid code returns the invalid word, except compare and to_int (see their meanings).
